name: IMZenX
description: Use IM and ZenX with the same local Agent and Thread.
mainDocument: IMZenX connects explicitly configured IM channels to this ZenX Host. Use status to inspect it. Configure only with user-supplied private channel configuration and a Python executable with the pinned SDK. In IM, /threads lists titles and numbers; /pick <number> selects one shared Thread and receives its replies in this conversation. Numbers refer to this conversation's last displayed list; refresh replaces it and after restart run /threads again. /new clears selection; the next ordinary message starts a new Thread. /subscribe and /unsubscribe remain select/clear aliases. Desktop replies on a subscribed Thread are delivered to IM. Never put bot credentials in tool arguments.
